title: Dalrymple ESCRI-SA Battery Energy Storage System: South Australia Minimum Operational Demand Thresholds Review
summary: AEMO documented a November 2019 state-of-charge constraint that limited Dalrymple's available frequency-control response. Phase 56E entity use: Project-reported event response and revenue remain separated from AEMO's independent constraint observation and from any counterfactual reliability claim.
key_findings: The record exposes a specific operating condition that qualifies nameplate or enabled-service claims.
Entity layer: Dalrymple 30 MW / 8 MWh battery in South Australia.
Compatibility boundary: Same asset; project and system-operator records overlap but use different windows and outcome measures.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: One constrained interval does not establish annual availability, dispatch, revenue, degradation, or reliability effect.
AEMO supplies an independent system observation; other results remain project-attributed through ARENA.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
